zones.title: End
zones.body: State ENDED and the reason on the session; the closing line from the market row. The sidecar hangs up after the goodbye audio stops.

panels.title: AR-57 EndCall
panels.body: The model calls it when the caller is done. The session gets state ENDED and the reason; the closing line comes from the market row, never from the model. The hangup itself is the sidecar's, after the audio of the goodbye has stopped.
